source_note: The 1944 invasion build-up in southern England. Sources: Wikipedia - Operation Overlord; Operation Neptune; Exercise Tiger (Slapton, Torbay, Dartmouth); Mulberry harbour (Phoenixes sunk at Dungeness and Pagham before D-Day); D-Day embarkation hards (Lepe, Stokes Bay and others survive). Areas and anchorages are placed at the named embarkation points; counts are illustrative and capped for performance.
